chunks: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said: “Regarding the fetus of a beast, if she miscarries it, then one-tenth of its price is due.”

key_terms.الْبَهِيمَةِ: the animal or beast in question
key_terms.جَنِينِ: the fetus; the unborn offspring in the womb
key_terms.فَأَلْقَتْ: she cast out; she miscarried or expelled the fetus

ai.seo_question: What compensation is due for the fetus of an animal if it is caused to be miscarried?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning liability for causing the loss of the fetus of an animal. It assigns compensation equal to one-tenth of its value, showing that financial responsibility applies in such cases within fiqh.
